title: Nutty Silky Jamaican Chicken Skillet
description: A bitter and silky weeknight Jamaican dish featuring enchilada sauce and shio-cure, this keto-friendly recipe is perfect for a quick dinner.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the enchilada sauce, almond butter, and shio-cure.
Pour the sauce mixture over the chicken and vegetables in the skillet.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, until the chicken is cooked through, about 10 minutes.
Stir in the chopped scallions, salt, and black pepper.
Serve the chicken and sauce hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
